179731: S-Class agent and Black Trigger user.
179733: A B-rank sniper and a member of Arafune Squad.
179735: Mirai is a former A-Class sniper of Ninomiya Unit.
179736: An operator for the B-Rank Azuma Squad at Border Headquarters. Thanks to her efforts, the Azuma Squad’s operations room is kept tidy—though it seems that, from time to time, she’ll plunge the room into total darkness to watch horror movies, all while laughing.
179737: A B-rank agent and the sniper of Nasu Squad.

179741: Sumiharu Inukai is a member of Ninomiya Squad.

179757: A B-Rank agent and an attacker of Nasu Squad.
179758: A Rank agent and Tachikawa squad operator.

179764: Kaho is the Operator of the Kazama Unit.
179765: She's the mother of Osamu Mikumo.

179772: A B-rank agent and the leader of Nasu Squad. Rei is a rather quiet and sickly girl, as she is often shown sitting in bed.
179773: A C-Rank sniper and Chika's friend.

179776: Hikari Nire is the operator of the B-Rank #2, Kageura Squad.
179779: Ranbanein is a Neighbor from Aftokrator.

179792: An attacker on the Ninomiya Squad—the top-ranked B-Class team at Border Headquarters.

264661: He is Yuuma Kuga's father and Border's former Commander-in-Chief.
